input_files.runtime_observation: Current unity_cli JSON envelopes and connected-instance descriptors

output_contract.normal_task_response: No additional fixed format is imposed.
output_contract.feedback_summary_condition: FeedbackMode is on, a real friction event occurred, and the recorder returned ok:true.
output_contract.no_friction_behavior: No feedback record and no feedback summary.

rollback_boundary.skill_install: The installer retains one fixed previous projection until the new runtime bundle passes filesystem readback.
rollback_boundary.feedback_mode: Bundle updates preserve the installed legal FeedbackMode value.
rollback_boundary.feedback_records: Append-only user-local records are not automatically rolled back; retention is bounded by one main file and three archives.
rollback_boundary.caller_authority: Timeout and retry decisions remain with the caller; governance metadata does not add an execution gate.

subprocess: powershell.exe for scripts/record-feedback.ps1 when FeedbackMode is on and friction occurred
